title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Endocrinologista em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

REMOTO

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade.
  • Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções.
  • Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis.
  • Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados.
  • Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema.
  • Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança.
  • Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação.
  • Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost.

  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas.
  • Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Data Focused)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer (Data Focused) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role and Team:

As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program.


Responsibilities:

● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers

● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features)

● Manage critical issues that impact customer’s business

● Work with R&D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product

● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers

● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community

● Work with Linux shell, RestAPI, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents


Work Hours : US East business hours.


Main Skills (What You’ve Already Accomplished...So Far):

● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications

● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications

● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level

● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, BusinessObjects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas

● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana

● You are familiar with cloud infrastructure AWS

● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers


Nice to have:

● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically Python)

● Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Hadoop

● Experience with RestAPI

description:

Location: 100% Remote

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’.

  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Upskilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.

As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. title: Video Creator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Creator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Assessment:

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’.

Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views).

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Edit premium short & long-form content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director, i.e. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing
  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional editing experience
  • A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media
  • Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates)
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script
  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Upskilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

title: Consultor de Estratégia e Transformação Digital | Industry & Services
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Estratégia e Transformação Digital | Industry & Services em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Buscamos um consultor sênior para integrar o time de advisory e pré-vendas da vertical Industry & Services, com foco em estratégia, transformação digital e operações industriais. Atuará no diagnóstico de problemas de negócio, na estruturação de soluções e na condução de conversas estratégicas com clientes, traduzindo oportunidades operacionais em propostas de valor sustentadas por tecnologia, dados e IA.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Conduzir discovery, diagnósticos operacionais e mapeamento de processos em clientes de óleo e gás, mineração, manufatura e setores correlatos, identificando oportunidades de eficiência e modernização.
  • Estruturar soluções de transformação digital, conectando dores de negócio a iniciativas de tecnologia, automação, analytics e IA generativa.
  • Construir propostas, decks executivos e materiais consultivos com qualidade e velocidade para suportar o ciclo de pré-vendas e conversas com lideranças do cliente.
  • Conduzir interações client facing com áreas de negócio e tecnologia, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas, priorização e clareza de valor.
  • Articular o ecossistema interno (especialistas, delivery, parceiros) para montar respostas integradas dentro dos prazos comerciais.
  • Apoiar a evolução do portfólio de ofertas da vertical, trazendo leitura de mercado, tendências e cases que inspirem novas oportunidades.


Perfil que buscamos

  • Formação em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas, com pós-graduação ou MBA considerados um diferencial.
  • Experiência sólida em consultoria (Big 4, boutiques de estratégia ou integradores) atuando em projetos de transformação digital, supply chain, operações ou estratégia para clientes industriais.
  • Vivência em diagnóstico de processos, modelagem de soluções e gestão de iniciativas em ambientes complexos e multidisciplinares.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura de Dados, AI/GenAI, Machine Learning e componentes Cloud.
  • Familiaridade com temas de Indústria 4.0, convergência IT/OT, supply chain analytics, gestão de ativos, torre de controle ou aplicações de IA em operações.
  • Domínio de Power BI e Excel avançado; conhecimentos de Python, SQL ou plataformas de dados são bem-vindos.
  • Inglês avançado para interlocução com fornecedores, parceiros e times globais.
  • Postura consultiva, estruturação clara de raciocínio, velocidade na construção de materiais e energia para conduzir o ambiente e conectar pessoas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em projetos para Agro, Alimentos & Bebidas, Bens de Consumo, Auto, Mineradoras ou grandes indústrias de Manufatura.
  • Vivência prática em iniciativas com IA generativa, agentes de LLM ou analytics avançado aplicado a operações.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Application Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Application Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A T-Systems , multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom , busca profissional sênior de TI com sólida experiência híbrida em arquitetura de aplicações, desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de bancos de dados, com foco particular na integração de sistemas externos por meio de tecnologias middleware como MQ, Kafka, SFTP e CFT. Especializado em ambientes COBOL e DB2 (LUW/zOS), com vasta experiência na integração de sistemas legados e plataformas distribuídas modernas.



Perfil desejado


  • Experiência comprovada no projeto e implementação de soluções de integração ponta a ponta, conectando aplicações mainframe com ambientes de nuvem e Linux (Azure).
  • Sólida experiência em administração de DB2, otimização de desempenho, modelagem de dados e integração de dados, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade de sistemas de missão crítica.
  • Experiência prática com plataformas middleware (IBM MQ, Axway CFT), protocolos de transferência de arquivos (SFTP/FTPS) e streaming de eventos (Kafka), possibilitando a troca de dados robusta e eficiente em ambientes de sistemas heterogêneos.
  • Habilidade em analisar e resolver desafios complexos de múltiplas camadas, abrangendo aplicações, dados e infraestrutura. Experiência em automação, processamento em lote (Control-M/JCL) e modernização de ambientes legados.
  • Reconhecido por uma mentalidade holística, orientada à arquitetura, fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e de negócios em ambientes internacionais.



Requisitos Técnicos


  • COBOL – experiência prática em desenvolvimento e entendimento de sistemas legados.
  • DB2 LUW e/ou DB2 z/OS :
  • Administração e manutenção
  • Backups e recovery
  • Modelagem e DDL (ex: criação de tabelas)
  • Gerenciamento de índices
  • Performance tuning e análise
  • Carga e extração de dados (Load/Unload)
  • Conhecimentos em Mainframe e sua integração com sistemas distribuídos.
  • Cloud (Azure) e ambientes Linux , incluindo automação via scripting.
  • Control-M / JCL – criação e administração de workflows e agendamento de jobs.
  • IBM MQ – configuração de channels, queues e uso de ferramentas como MQ Explorer.
  • Rocket Enterprise Server .
  • Axway CFT – configuração de fluxos de transferência.
  • Protocolos de transferência: SFTP, FTPS .



Idiomas

  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)
  • Alemão (diferencial relevante)



Outros Requisitos

  • Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário da Alemanha .

  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a serviços e/ou ambientes serverless;

  • Vivência em construção, evolução e definição de arquitetura técnica;

  • Experiência em ambientes de startup e crescimento acelerado.

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Data Focused)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Support Engineer (Data Focused) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role and Team:

As a Technical Support Engineer you will work with leading enterprise organizations and startups to realize the power of data analytics. Our Technical Support team spans the globe and has recently begun a major transformation effort to move to a SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizational structure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing. Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program.


Responsibilities:

● Investigate technical problems and diagnose root causes in Linux and Windows servers

● Develop, design, and propose solutions to meet the technological and business needs of customers (e.g. workarounds for product issues and additional features)

● Manage critical issues that impact customer’s business

● Work with R&D and Product teams to meet customer requirements and improve our product

● Present complex technical information about the product to the customers

● Take part in the creation and maintenance of our knowledge-based and community

● Work with Linux shell, RestAPI, Web applications troubleshooting, application installations, identifying process improvements, debugging, comprehending technical documents


Work Hours : US East business hours.


Main Skills (What You’ve Already Accomplished...So Far):

● You already experienced with supporting complex product infrastructure and applications

● You have experience with troubleshooting web applications

● You have experience with databases such as MS SQL, MySQL, Oracle etc, SQL scripting at least at basic level

● You already worked with ETL and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Talend, SSRS, BusinessObjects, Cognos etc OR you are able to write and understand complex formulas

● You have experience working with logs, and various monitoring tools such as Grafana, New Relic, Kibana

● You are familiar with cloud infrastructure AWS

● You have experience in communication with English-speaking customers


Nice to have:

● Web development background and/or programming familiarity ( specifically Python)

● Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Hadoop

● Experience with RestAPI

title: Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Specialist Cloud Architect (AWS) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Cloud Architect Especialista para atuar em um time estratégico de alta maturidade técnica, com foco em modernização de aplicações, infraestrutura em nuvem AWS e práticas avançadas de DevOps.

Esse profissional será referência técnica, apoiando decisões arquiteturais complexas, definindo padrões, garantindo governança e assegurando a adoção das melhores práticas do AWS Well-Architected Framework em soluções de missão crítica.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura em nuvem AWS;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenho, validação e evolução de arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, seguras, resilientes e eficientes;
  • Desenvolver soluções, modelos de referência, frameworks e ferramentas para a plataforma AWS;
  • Provisionar, configurar e gerenciar infraestrutura em AWS, garantindo padrões de segurança, performance e custo;
  • Definir e implementar pipelines de automação utilizando Infrastructure as Code (IaC) com Terraform, AWS CloudFormation e AWS CDK (Python);
  • Estruturar, evoluir e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD para deploy de aplicações, agentes e ferramentas;
  • Garantir conformidade das soluções com o AWS Well-Architected Framework;
  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos técnicos e não técnicos, apoiando decisões estratégicas de arquitetura;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança, governança e observabilidade;
  • Promover compartilhamento de conhecimento, mentoria técnica e apoio à evolução do time.


Requisitos e qualificações obrigatórios


  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de atuação comprovada em CTPS;
  • Experiência sólida e aprofundada com AWS;
  • Experiência sólida com AWS CDK (Python), AWS CloudFormation e Terraform;
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos, definição e desenho arquitetural, provisionamento, configuração e desenvolvimento de recursos AWS;
  • Experiência na estruturação e evolução de esteiras CI/CD, containers, Git, boas práticas DevOps e padrões de segurança;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação técnica para interação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.


Habilidades comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara, estratégica e assertiva;
  • Capacidade de conduzir discussões técnicas complexas e negociações arquiteturais;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico;
  • Perfil de referência técnica, com atuação consultiva e de mentoria;
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Forte orientação à qualidade, eficiência e resultados;
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão em ambientes complexos.



Sobre a empresa


Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: LATAM Decom Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LATAM Decom Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



About the Role


The LATAM Decom Project Manager leads large-scale delivery programs executed through Managed Service Providers (MSPs) for hyperscaler environments. This role ensures end-to-end delivery of datacenter, network, and infrastructure projects across global regions with strict adherence to SLAs, security standards, compliance frameworks, and operational excellence. The PM serves as the primary interface between the hyperscaler, MSPs, vendors, and internal engineering teams.



Responsibilities



Program & Project Delivery

  • Lead planning, execution, and delivery of MSP-supported projects across compute, network, storage, and data-center operations.
  • Manage project lifecycle including scoping, resourcing, budgets, timelines, risks, and change control.
  • Maintain alignment with hyperscaler operational frameworks, including capacity build-outs, decom, retrofits, and infra expansions.
  • Coordinate regional and global deployments across multiple time zones with follow-the-sun governance.


Vendor & MSP Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all ISPs delivering onsite or remote services.
  • Enforce SLA compliance & and quality KPIs.
  • Conduct regular governance calls, internal and external.
  • Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement with vendors.


Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Remove blockers, escalate critical issues, and maintain reliable delivery pipelines.
  • Ensure consistent communication between internal teams and external ISPs.
  • Coordinate with Global Logistics for shipping the orders to ensure SLAs are met.


Delivery Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate documentation including MOPs (Methods of Procedure), SOPs, RACI, and risk registers.
  • Maintain end-to-end asset traceability using internal tooling (Salesforce).


Reporting & Metrics

  • Provide weekly and monthly executive reports on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and mitigations.
  • Track, productivity, throughput, and cycle-time metrics.



Qualifications


  • 8–12+ years of project/program management in large-scale datacenter or cloud infrastructure environments.
  • Experience working with or within hyperscalers.
  • Strong background managing MSP vendors delivering hardware, network, logistics, and field operations.
  • Deep understanding of data-center operational workflows, racks/cabling, networking basics, migrations, decom, and capacity builds.
  • Proficiency with PM tools.
  • Excellent communication, executive reporting, and stakeholder negotiation skills.
  • Experience with Lean, Agile, or scaled delivery frameworks.



Preferred Skills


  • PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or equivalent certifications.
  • Experience with global, multi-region deployments across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Ability to analyze operational metrics, and implement continuous improvement.



Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at .


Sycomp complies with applicable AI regulations worldwide and adheres to the most rigorous standards. These tools assist our teams, and all final hiring decisions are made following human review. If you have questions or concerns about our process, please contact us at .

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil (Remote)


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Sales Manager, Laparoscopy Systems
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sales Manager, Laparoscopy Systems em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Reach Surgical, a Genesis Medtech Company, is a leading minimally-invasive surgical device manufacturer and supplier, committed to serving high-quality products to healthcare practitioners and patients worldwide. We deliver advanced technology and cost effective minimally-invasive surgical products to medical institutions and provide patients with reliable and economical treatment solutions.


About the Role


We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager to spearhead regional sales management, drive business growth, and accelerate the expansion of Laparoscopic products for Brazil.


Responsibilities


As the Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the sales management of Laparoscopic products within the assigned geographic area and markets to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. You will conduct market research including customers and competitors’ activities and formulate and execute market development strategies. In addition, you will develop and build long-lasting relationships with stakeholders including distributors and healthcare professionals and obtain feedback on our products to internal stakeholders.


1. Development and Execution of Sales Plans


  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Define clear and measurable overseas sales goals, develop corresponding action plans, and execute them effectively to meet company objectives.
  • Market Intelligence: Conduct detailed hospital and micro-market analysis; maintain up-to-date market intelligence to understand industry trends and competitive landscapes.
  • Competitive Strategy: Formulate and implement effective competitive strategies based on insights into market dynamics and competitor activities.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support regional marketing activities, leverage internal and external resources efficiently, and enhance overall customer value.
  • Decision-Making: Maintain a deep understanding of regional market conditions; identify emerging opportunities and potential challenges to make informed and timely decisions.


2. KOL (Key Opinion Leader) Management


  • Database Development : Establish and maintain a comprehensive overseas KOL information archive.
  • Customer Insight : Analyze the potential and specific needs of KOLs to develop targeted engagement plans.
  • Relationship Management : Strategically allocate resources to build, strengthen, and sustain long-term cooperative relationships with KOLs.


3. Distributor Management


  • Distributor Development : Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors that meet company criteria and strategic alignment.
  • Performance Support & Training: Provide motivation, ongoing support, and training to ensure distributors adhere to company standards and deliver expected outcomes.
  • Channel Optimization : Demonstrate strong communication and distributor management skills; conduct regular performance reviews and offer actionable feedback to maintain an effective and healthy distribution network.


Qualifications & Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Management, Marketing, Trade, Life Sciences, Clinical Sciences or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in international sales or business development, preferably experience in the laparoscopic industry.
  • Proficiency in English is required
  • Strong sales and negotiation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with experience in cross-cultural communication.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: Customer Support Representative, Level 1
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Support Representative, Level 1 em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

We are seeking an experienced Customer Support Representative to be on the front lines by answering questions and troubleshooting technical problems. You will assist customers with JoVE’s products and also guide clients through any technical issue they might encounter. If you are an energetic self-starter problem solver with a basic technical background and excellent communication skills, we want to talk to you. The Support Team here at JoVE is providing support not only to external customers but also to internal JoVE employees on a 24x7 basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Manage large amounts of incoming tickets.
  • Provide support to answer inquiries on products.
  • Accept and handle technical requests.
  • Triage tickets to the other teams.
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines and policies.
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools.
  • Build sustainable relationships and trust with customers through open communication.
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution.
  • Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts and file documents.
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers.
  • Performs other specific duties or assignments as directed by Team Manager.


Skills And Qualifications:


  • A Bachelor’s degree completed
  • 2+ years of demonstrable experience in customer support or customer success roles
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, verbal and written, are required to effectively and accurately communicate in English.
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical personnel in a clear and easy fashion.
  • Basic understanding of KPIs and Metrics.
  • Attention to detail is key to this position.
  • Must be able to accommodate flexible work schedules based on business needs.
  • Must have technical/diagnostic ability along with analytical ability to diagnose problems above basics, and basic mechanical skills.
  • Proficient with ticketing tools ( Zendesk, Jira, Salesforce).


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Esta função é estratégica para nossas soluções de marketing orientadas a dados. Buscamos alguém que combine domínio técnico em engenharia de dados com afinidade real por inteligência artificial e experiência prática com Databricks.

  • Desenvolve e mantém pipelines de dados em Databricks, usando PySpark e Delta Lake para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados em escala.
  • Constrói e sustenta fluxos ETL/ELT robustos, com foco em qualidade, rastreabilidade e performance.
  • Aplica conceitos de IA e Machine Learning no contexto de dados de marketing, colaborando com times de ciência de dados na preparação e feature engineering de datasets.
  • Escreve SQL e código Python com qualidade de produção, incluindo testes unitários e revisão técnica.
  • Contribui para arquiteturas de Data Lakehouse, incluindo organização de camadas (Bronze/Silver/Gold) e governança de dados.
  • Participa de revisões de projeto e código, propondo melhorias técnicas com consistência.

  • Experiência sólida com Databricks (notebooks, clusters, Jobs, Unity Catalog).
  • Domínio de SQL e Python para manipulação e transformação de dados.
  • Conhecimento em PySpark e Delta Lake.
  • Experiência com ferramentas e conceitos de ETL/ELT.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps ou integração de modelos de IA em pipelines de dados.
  • Entendimento de infraestrutura de dados: armazenamento em nuvem, orquestração de jobs e controle de versão.
  • Afinidade com metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e boas práticas de engenharia de software.


Diferencial


  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) integradas ao Databricks.
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, embeddings ou pipelines de dados para aplicações generativas.
  • Conhecimento em espanhol.

Sobre a dentsu internacional

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.

Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.

  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.

  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).

  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS) .
  • Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT).
  • Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes.
  • Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes).
  • Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados.
  • Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures).
  • Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault).
  • Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados.
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS).
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados.


O que oferecemos

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Flexibilidade de horário.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.
  • Programa de capacitação continuada.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

In this role, you will work on both our client's and their clients' software products bridging the gap between development and operations. You will do so by leveraging your expertise in cloud technologies and DevOps principles to design, build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and applications.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines
  • Develop and implement automated CI/CD workflows
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize AI/ML models, services, and applications in production environments
  • Establish best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, reliability, and security
  • Build frameworks and tooling to streamline feature release velocity while maintaining system stability and compliance
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling (e.g., code generation, testing automation, AIOps) into DevOps workflows
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost efficiency across distributed systems
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system resilience
  • Advise on DevOps maturity, cloud architecture, and AI-enabled engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
  • Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer, LLM APIs) and their integration into workflows
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Experience with security best practices in cloud and DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, compliance)
  • Ability to design systems that balance delivery speed with reliability and governance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
