  • Experiência com ecossistema Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake e Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2;
  • Forte conhecimento em Databricks e processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
  • Experiência em arquiteturas modernas de dados, como Lakehouse, trabalhando com camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold;
  • Vivência com cargas full e incrementais (delta load), garantindo integridade, consistência e sincronização dos dados;
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de pipelines, troubleshooting, tuning de performance e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud;
  • Experiência com dados estruturados e semiestruturados voltados para analytics, reporting e iniciativas de IA/ML;

  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de dados, times analíticos e stakeholders de negócio.

  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Automated hedging engines

  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms

Skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .

  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Especialista Modern Work - Intune
description:

  • Sólida experiência com Microsoft Intune em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Forte experiência com SCCM (Configuration Manager) :

  • Experiência com Microsoft Entra ID, Acesso Condicional e identidade híbrida .
  • Vivência com Autopilot, Autopatch e modernização de gerenciamento .
  • Experiência com empacotamento de aplicações (Win32, MSI, scripts) .

  • Experiência com automação (PowerShell / Graph API) .
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de certificados (PKI) .



Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) e Windows 365 .
  • Conhecimento em Zero Trust .
  • Certificações Microsoft (MD-102, MS-102, AZ-900, etc.).


**Vaga Híbrida - (90% H.O, 10% com possibilidades de viagens nível Brasil)



O que oferecemos?

Contratação CLT

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

Auxílio creche;

Convênio com Farmácia;

Cartão GoodCard;

Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

Gympass



  • O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Treasury Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company’s credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.

The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)

• Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.

• Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.

• Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.

• Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.

• Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.

• Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.

• Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.

• Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.

• Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.

• Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.

• Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.


Cash Management & Treasury Operations

• Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.

• Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.

• Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.

• Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.

• Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.

• Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.

• Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.

• Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.

• Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities.

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.

• Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.

• Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization.

Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

Professional Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.

• Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.


Technical Knowledge

• Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.

• Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.

• Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.

• Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.

• Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Languages

• Advanced English (required).

• Intermediate Spanish (desirable).


Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

title: Tech Lead ReactJS
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead ReactJS em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

(Tech Lead React)

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.



Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?



Qual será o seu papel?


Atuar como referência técnica em frontend, liderando a construção e evolução de soluções digitais com foco em performance, escalabilidade e experiência do usuário. Como Tech Lead React, você será responsável por guiar o time nas decisões arquiteturais, garantir a qualidade das entregas e promover boas práticas de desenvolvimento, fomentando um ambiente colaborativo, de aprendizado contínuo e alta performance.



Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Liderança e Mentoria: Alinhar objetivos, identificar necessidades de treinamento e garantir o
  • nivelamento técnico da equipe.
  • Gestão de Processos: Acompanhar o ciclo de desenvolvimento, mitigar riscos de entrega e
  • apoiar o time de projetos em cronogramas e estimativas.
  • Excelência Técnica: Liderar o desenvolvimento web, criando componentes reutilizáveis,
  • realizando revisões de código (code review) e garantindo a adoção de padrões de qualidade.
  • Colaboração Multidisciplinar: Atuar próximo aos times de Design e Backend para
  • implementação de interfaces responsivas, acessíveis e otimizadas.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Identificar gargalos de performance no frontend e manter o projeto
  • atualizado com as melhores práticas do mercado.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento frontend.
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript.
  • Domínio profundo de React e seu ecossistema (Redux, React Router, Context API).
  • Experiência prática com o framework Remix.
  • Domínio de Tailwind CSS, além de HTML5, CSS3 e pré-processadores (SASS/LESS).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git).
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Prática com testes de frontend (Jest, React Testing Library).
  • Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful e práticas de DevOps/CI-CD.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de design e prototipagem (Figma).


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com infraestrutura em nuvem voltada para frontend.
  • Possuir experiência com ferramentas de teste end-to-end como Cypress ou Playwright.
  • Tiver experiência com Micro-frontends, Design Patterns e Clean Architecture aplicados ao
  • Frontend.
  • Dominar conceitos de Core Web Vitals, renderização no servidor (SSR), hidratação
  • progressiva e estratégias de cache.




Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Treasury Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company’s credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.

The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)

• Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.

• Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.

• Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.

• Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.

• Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.

• Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.

• Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.

• Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.

• Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.

• Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.

• Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.


Cash Management & Treasury Operations

• Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.

• Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.

• Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.

• Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.

• Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.

• Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.

• Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.

• Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.

• Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities.

Stakeholder Management

• Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.

• Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.

• Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization.

Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.

Professional Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.

• Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.


Technical Knowledge

• Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.

• Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.

• Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.

• Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.

• Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.

• Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Languages

• Advanced English (required).

• Intermediate Spanish (desirable).

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.

  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Generative AI Video Creator em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Generative AI Video Creator / AI Video Creator / Gen AI Video Creator

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Submission Form :

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok. ───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE: We're looking for a GenAI Video Creator who uses AI-native tools as a primary production method, not as a shortcut, but as a craft. You'll produce high-performance content for social media, websites, and beyond, blending AI-generated visuals, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, not just views.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Generate and direct AI-native video content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director: prompt, generate, select, and combine AI assets, visuals, motion, sound, voiceover, music, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing using AI-first workflows
  • Adapt styles and aesthetics intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Composite and refine AI outputs in post to a polished, publish-ready standard
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 2+ years of experience producing content with AI-native tools
  • A portfolio of AI-generated content with links to work currently live on social media
  • Hands-on proficiency with leading GenAI video platforms (e.g. Veo, Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, HeyGen, or equivalent)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with the ability to direct AI outputs with precision and intention
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently shape AI-generated footage into a coherent, engaging narrative from a brief or concept alone
  • Working knowledge of Premiere Pro or equivalent for post-production and compositing
  • A strong eye for design, visual consistency, and brand aesthetics
  • Sound judgement on music, audio design, and pacing for platform-native content
  • A deep understanding of hooks, retention, and what makes AI content feel intentional rather than generated
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver polished AI-generated content with a human level of creative intention
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project ───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Access to leading AI platforms and tools as part of your workflow ───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required submission form:
  • Optional: Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without examples of work will not be considered.

title: Desenvolvedor (a) Back end Java SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor (a) Back end Java SR em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Código da vaga: 87c2


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Java- venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Conhecimento avançado em Spring (Boot , Data, Cache, MVC, Data, Security, etc.) ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java ;
  • Prática com serviços AWS como EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation, entre outros;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços , mensageria (Kafka, SQS) e containers (Docker);
  • Banco de dados: Relacionais (SQL. Exemplo: Aurora, Redshift e Postgresql) e Não relacionais (BigQuery, Datastore/Firestore, MongoDB, ElasticSearch);
  • Conhecimentos de CI/CD , Git , Integração com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais ;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e APIs);
  • Vivência em Metodologia ágil Scrum/Kanban
  • Conhecimento em DevOps e infraestrutura Cloud





Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer (Relocation to Portugal) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

• +4 years of experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer;

• Strong experience in SFMC development and automation;

• Hands-on experience with AMPscript, SQL, HTML/CSS, and Journey Builder;

• Experience with API integrations and Data Extensions;

• Knowledge of Email Studio, Automation Studio, and Journey Builder;

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments;

  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.



Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.


Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.


What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions


You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management


Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.


To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Gastroenterologista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor full stack em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack PL/SR


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções web escaláveis, com foco em front-end, back-end e cloud . title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced spoken and written English skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

title: Generative AI Video Creator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Generative AI Video Creator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Generative AI Video Creator / AI Video Creator / Gen AI Video Creator

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Submission Form :

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok. ───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE: We're looking for a GenAI Video Creator who uses AI-native tools as a primary production method, not as a shortcut, but as a craft. You'll produce high-performance content for social media, websites, and beyond, blending AI-generated visuals, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, not just views.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Generate and direct AI-native video content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director: prompt, generate, select, and combine AI assets, visuals, motion, sound, voiceover, music, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing using AI-first workflows
  • Adapt styles and aesthetics intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Composite and refine AI outputs in post to a polished, publish-ready standard
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 2+ years of experience producing content with AI-native tools
  • A portfolio of AI-generated content with links to work currently live on social media
  • Hands-on proficiency with leading GenAI video platforms (e.g. Veo, Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, HeyGen, or equivalent)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with the ability to direct AI outputs with precision and intention
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently shape AI-generated footage into a coherent, engaging narrative from a brief or concept alone
  • Working knowledge of Premiere Pro or equivalent for post-production and compositing
  • A strong eye for design, visual consistency, and brand aesthetics
  • Sound judgement on music, audio design, and pacing for platform-native content
  • A deep understanding of hooks, retention, and what makes AI content feel intentional rather than generated
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver polished AI-generated content with a human level of creative intention
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project ───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Access to leading AI platforms and tools as part of your workflow ───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required submission form:
  • Optional: Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without examples of work will not be considered.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a senior backend-oriented engineer to help build backend-heavy internal systems for a healthcare company. The ideal candidate will work closely with product and stakeholders to conduct discovery sessions, understand business needs, ask the right questions, design safe integrations, collaborate closely with product/ops teams, and help create the technical foundation for future growth.

The company provides health-related services through a network of care professionals and is building internal systems to support and scale its operations.

- Strong product collaboration skills

- Familiarity with using AI tools in the software development pipeline, including planning, implementation support, code review, testing, documentation, and improving development workflows


Nice to have:

- Experience with Healthie or other EHR systems

- US healthcare experience

- Billing, invoicing, insurance, or payments experience

- Prior tech lead experience

- Experience as the first or primary engineer on a product/project

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Information Technology Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Generative AI Video Creator
description:

Job Title: Generative AI Video Creator / AI Video Creator / Gen AI Video Creator

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Submission Form :

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok. ───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE: We're looking for a GenAI Video Creator who uses AI-native tools as a primary production method, not as a shortcut, but as a craft. You'll produce high-performance content for social media, websites, and beyond, blending AI-generated visuals, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, not just views.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Generate and direct AI-native video content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director: prompt, generate, select, and combine AI assets, visuals, motion, sound, voiceover, music, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing using AI-first workflows
  • Adapt styles and aesthetics intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Composite and refine AI outputs in post to a polished, publish-ready standard
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 2+ years of experience producing content with AI-native tools
  • A portfolio of AI-generated content with links to work currently live on social media
  • Hands-on proficiency with leading GenAI video platforms (e.g. Veo, Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, HeyGen, or equivalent)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with the ability to direct AI outputs with precision and intention
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently shape AI-generated footage into a coherent, engaging narrative from a brief or concept alone
  • Working knowledge of Premiere Pro or equivalent for post-production and compositing
  • A strong eye for design, visual consistency, and brand aesthetics
  • Sound judgement on music, audio design, and pacing for platform-native content
  • A deep understanding of hooks, retention, and what makes AI content feel intentional rather than generated
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver polished AI-generated content with a human level of creative intention
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project ───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Access to leading AI platforms and tools as part of your workflow ───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required submission form:
  • Optional: Include your portfolio, CV, and a 2–4 sentence cover note.
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without examples of work will not be considered.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio.


This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week.


Compensation:

$250 USD per week, paid weekly.


What you'll do:

- Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends

- Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing

- Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts

- Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability

- Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels

- Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions


You may be a great fit if you:

- Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely

- Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers

- Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations

- Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive

- Communicate clearly and can work independently

- Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management


Nice to have:

- Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management

- Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting

- Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you.


To apply, please include:

- Your resume

- A short note about your relevant experience

- Your LinkedIn profile, if available

Código da vaga: 87c2


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Java- venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Conhecimento avançado em Spring (Boot , Data, Cache, MVC, Data, Security, etc.) ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java ;
  • Prática com serviços AWS como EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation, entre outros;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços , mensageria (Kafka, SQS) e containers (Docker);
  • Banco de dados: Relacionais (SQL. Exemplo: Aurora, Redshift e Postgresql) e Não relacionais (BigQuery, Datastore/Firestore, MongoDB, ElasticSearch);
  • Conhecimentos de CI/CD , Git , Integração com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais ;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e APIs);
  • Vivência em Metodologia ágil Scrum/Kanban
  • Conhecimento em DevOps e infraestrutura Cloud





Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Processo seletivo afirmativo para mulheres.


Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Local de trabalho: Remoto


Modelo de trabalho: CLT


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Delegar tarefas e atribuições ao time técnico, dando todo o apoio necessário para que evoluam rapidamente na perspectiva técnica, se tornando de alta performance
  • Conduzir efetivos 1:1 com o seu time técnico
  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico (usuário, veículo, débitos, pagamentos, etc).
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Conduzir a resolução de problemas e contribuir ativamente com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Python, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhecer todas essas tecnologias, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.
  • Conduzir auditorias de segurança e estrutura em busca de oportunidades de melhorias.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:

  • Ter experiência com mensageria na comunicação entre serviços

  • Pessoas que buscam aprender e fazer parte de uma solução de alto impacto, entregando software de alta qualidade e orientado por dados.


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você:


  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis focadas no cliente;
  • Possuir experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.;
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo;
  • Conhecer metodologia Scrum e agilidade;
  • Tiver Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Sabe testar e escalar.

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)

  • VA para compras em supermercados

title: Consultor de investimentos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de investimentos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da geral:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Profissional Financeiro com certificação CPA-10 ou CPA-20 para atuar no suporte e atendimento a clientes, análise de perfil de investidor, e distribuição de produtos financeiros.   • Facilidade com sistemas bancários, Excel e plataformas de investimento;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e foco em resultados.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações adicionais (CEA, CFP®, ANCORD);
